title: SG-000096 continuation: interactive shells on the Orcel authority service
draft_note: Amendment draft under prep/ (revision 7). The activation PR (WP1-00) applies these changes to .specgrain/specs/SG-000096.json, which stays in state GRAIN; it does not replace the existing spec.
decision: DECIDED (founder, 2026-11-17, FD-UP-4 and FD-UP-9): continue SG-000096 so interactive shells land in Wave 1 for J-3b, with comprehensive shell coverage.

dependency_notes_add.SG-000132: Lease checks, the dispatcher, standing approvals and stop come from the authority service; shell sessions are dispatched only through crates/orceld/src/full_control_dispatch.rs.
dependency_notes_add.SG-000131: Contracts and audit chain; argv recorded as digests.

scope_include_add: Shells under a Full User lease on Windows: PowerShell 5.1, PowerShell 7, cmd, Git Bash and WSL bash, each as an interactive ConPTY session or one-shot command, on the user's desktop with the user's token.

Each session's process tree in a Job Object created and owned by the authority service (session granted only JOB_OBJECT_ASSIGN_PROCESS, no breakaway), started suspended, assigned and resumed, terminated by stop, expiry, session lock and sign-out.
Shell sessions coverable by a standing approval for the same client, declared task and scope (working directories and, where declared, command patterns).
Track X follow-up: zsh and bash on macOS and Linux (WPX-03).
changes.scope_note_replace: Where the existing spec refers to crates/orcel-policy/src/full_control_store.rs and crates/orcel-lifecycle/src/full_control.rs for lease issuance and verification, read the authority service of SG-000132; the requirement to qualify an ordinary current-user token (not the AppContainer execution mode) stands.
acceptance_add: Each listed shell runs interactively and one-shot under a lease on the Windows runner, with bounded stdout and stderr pagination, and is killed by stop within 1 s.
Without a lease, ShellProcess stays denied and Safe process behaviour is unchanged.
